//port: Leave this at 8080. To serve on another port, change the left-hand side of the ports mapping in docker-compose.yml instead.
//libraries: Paths *inside the container*. Whatever you mount at /media is scanned; there is no need to change this unless you mount somewhere else.
//maxDepth: How many subfolder levels deep to look inside each library.
//exclude: Folder name patterns to skip entirely. Supports * wildcards.
